_note: Toll test used by routes.py. A route is marked toll when (a) OSRM tags a step with the toll class, (b) steps whose ref/name match ref_patterns add up to at least min_step_km, or (c) at least min_geom_km of its simplified geometry lies within buffer_m of a corridor polyline below. Corridor polylines are rough hand-placed lon/lat points, good to a few hundred metres only; (b) does most of the work. Prices are deliberately not recorded.
ref_patterns_note: VA 267 is both the Dulles Toll Road and the Greenway. The Dulles Access Road (airport traffic only) also carries the 267 ref in OSM.
